alt: A simplified 8-slot model of what a dictionary does inside. Each code lands in slot code mod 8; a taken slot probes forward to the next one. A lookup repeats the same walk: one step when the slot is free or already holds the code, a short probe on a collision, and an empty slot means the code was never stored.

steps.caption: 3 % 8 = 3: an empty slot, so it goes straight in.
11 % 8 = 3, but slot 3 is taken. Probing forward lands it in slot 4.
19 % 8 = 3, but slot 3 is taken. Probing forward lands it in slot 5.
Looking up 19: 19 % 8 = 3, but slot 3 holds a different code, so probing forward finds 19 in slot 5.
Looking up 5: 5 % 8 = 5, but slot 5 holds another code. Slot 6 is empty, so 5 was never stored.
